g.text: With the cap — five times an equal share

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1c1a17

g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL — the accrual cap tightens as a community grows

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Not measured data. A simulation using an assumed volunteer-contribution skew, showing the cap's intended effect at different

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: community sizes. The cap is five times an equal share of the new money a cycle commits to distribution, both tiers counted together

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: (Founding Charter 5.3, Contribution Code 4.3) — so it is 10% at 50 members and 0.5% at 1,000, falling automatically as membership

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: rises. Triarchal Democracy has not been deployed at these scales; this illustrates mechanism design intent, not an observed outcome.
